title: pagination: buggy first/previous/next/last logic
body:
I feel like the logic used to hide/show the various previous/first/next/last links is buggy. Here are some screenshots:

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11271018/a7396350-8ec3-11e5-8447-9bec6f94415a.png)
^ I'm on the first page, everything is alright.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11271025/b2b4abb8-8ec3-11e5-846c-4ea1d8dd674a.png)
^ I'm on the second page, I don't think the "<<" (first page) link is needed (redundant with "<" previous)

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11271042/cc02a37c-8ec3-11e5-9191-16130d96d074.png)
^ 4th page, everything is alright

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11271048/d47b6d18-8ec3-11e5-8749-520d2570f62f.png)
^ 5th page, oops the 6th page link disappeared. And I have both next and last (last might be useless here, and related to #594)
